verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented way to generate or edit a Pipedream workflow from a natural-language prompt. The closest items are a homepage tagline about prompting AI agents (a different artifact from workflows), AI-assisted error debugging (an adjacent feature), and a REST API that creates workflows programmatically (a developer building block, not natural-language authoring). None of these earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt
